headline: Sabres place Jack Rathbone on waivers
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Sabres have placed Jack Rathbone on waivers. The outlet notes he hasn't played a game in the NHL or AHL this season because of injury.

This is a roster move more than a hockey one. Buffalo's blue line has settled: Rasmus Dahlin and Mattias Samuelsson have played about 163 minutes together at 5-on-5, and Owen Power with Olen Zellweger nearly 135, the second pair controlling 56% of the expected goals (chance quality). Even healthy, Rathbone would be competing for a depth spot behind them.

The Sabres sit 8-5-3 with an even 49.98% share of expected goals. If another team claims him, it gets a puck-moving defenseman for nothing. If nobody does, Buffalo can send him to the AHL, where he can finally get games.
